text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space on the west side of Embla Street.

North York Community Council: 1. Designated an on-street accessible parking space in effect at all times on the west side of Embla Street, from a point 51 metres north of Barber Greene Road to a point 5.5 metres further north. 2. Rescinded the winter maintenance parking prohibition in effect from 2:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m., December 1st to March 31st, on the west side of Embla Street, from a point 51 metres north of Barber Greene Road to a point 5.5 metres further north.
